# AnotherSEOGuru - Platform Index & Directory
Source: https://anotherseoguru.com
Last Updated: 2026-10-20

> AnotherSEOGuru is the web design and SEO brand of Touristas Technologies, which owns anotherseoguru.com and the app at app.anotherseoguru.com. The agency serves businesses in Greece and international clients, specializing in tourism and hospitality websites, with GEO/AEO (AI visibility) services and a GSC-native SEO software platform.

## Core Hubs & Features
- **Greek Homepage** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el>) - Primary Greek entry for agency services, tourism SEO, and quotes.
- **English Homepage** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en>) - International entry for web design, SEO, GEO/AEO, and portfolio.
- **Agency Pricing** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/pricing>) - Transparent EUR packages for websites and monthly SEO retainers.
- **Τιμές & Πακέτα** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/pricing>) - Διαφανείς τιμές σε ευρώ για κατασκευή ιστοσελίδας και SEO.
- **Get a Quote** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/get-started>) - Scoped quote request - reply within 24 hours.
- **Ξεκινήστε / Προσφορά** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/get-started>) - Φόρμα προσφοράς στα ελληνικά.
- **SEO guru** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/seo-guru>) - Who the SEO guru is, the Search Console method, services and pricing. Greek twin at /el/seo-guru.
- **SEO guru (Ελληνικά)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/seo-guru>) - Ποιος είναι ο SEO guru, η μέθοδος από το Search Console, υπηρεσίες και τιμές.
- **Services Hub** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/services>) - All productized agency services.
- **Υπηρεσίες** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/el/services>) - Όλες οι υπηρεσίες κατασκευής ιστοσελίδων και SEO.
- **AI Visibility (GEO / AEO)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/services/ai-visibility>) - AI SEO agency for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews citations.
- **E-shop WooCommerce** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/services/eshop-woocommerce>) - Custom WooCommerce stores with payments and SEO structure.
- **Local SEO & GBP** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/services/local-seo>) - Map Pack and Google Business Profile optimization.
- **Industry Solutions** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/solutions>) - Vertical websites and SEO by industry.
- **Hotels & Hospitality** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/solutions/hotels>) - Hotel websites, booking UX, and tourism SEO.
- **Rent-a-Car** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/solutions/rent-a-car>) - Fleet catalogs, booking funnels, island/airport local SEO.
- **Portfolio / Case Studies** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/work>) - 42 documented client projects with homepage screenshots.
- **Blog** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/blog>) - SEO, GEO/AEO, hotel, and e-shop guides (EN + EL).
- **SEO guides** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/seo-guides>) - Index of the ranking guides and the cluster on keywords, on-page, technical SEO, links and local search (EN + EL).
- **AnotherSEOGuru App (SEO software)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform>) - Google Search Console-native SEO software: ranked fixes with click estimates, rank tracking, site audit, AI visibility. Web app at app.anotherseoguru.com (EN + EL).
- **AnotherSEOGuru App for iPhone (beta)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/iphone>) - Native iOS 17+ app on the same account: weekly fixes, rank tracking, alerts, AI evidence, widgets. In TestFlight beta, not yet on the App Store.
- **AnotherSEOGuru App integrations (one login)** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/integrations>) - One AnotherSEOGuru account for the web app, iPhone, Chrome extension, WordPress plugin and AI assistants (MCP); manage them in Settings → Connected apps (EN + EL).
- **SEO Chrome extension** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/chrome-extension>) - Free on-page SEO checks (meta, headings, links, images, schema, Open Graph, hreflang, Core Web Vitals) and Google results tools without an account; signed in, the page's own Search Console data. Coming to the Chrome Web Store.
- **WordPress SEO plugin** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/wordpress>) - Free full WordPress SEO plugin: live Google preview, SEO and readability analysis (Greek-aware), schema graph, XML sitemaps, redirects and 404 monitor, robots.txt/llms.txt and AI crawler controls, breadcrumbs; Search Console data, keyword research and AI titles in the editor; imports from Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress. Zip download; WordPress.org listing coming.
- **Google Search Console MCP server** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/platform/mcp>) - Search Console data, fix list, tasks and AI visibility in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf. Remote server https://app.anotherseoguru.com/mcp (OAuth) or npx @anotherseoguru/mcp login.
- **AnotherSEOGuru App docs** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/help>) - How the SEO software works on the web and iPhone: Search Console setup, opportunities, rank tracking, site audit, AI visibility, agency tools and billing (EN + EL). Every docs page has a Markdown twin at its URL + ".md".
- **SEO glossary** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/en/glossary>) - Over 100 SEO, AEO and GEO terms, one page each with definition, example and how to apply it (EN + EL).

## Machine-Readable Feeds for AI Agents
Structured context so AI assistants and AI search engines can cite accurate AnotherSEOGuru facts:

- **llms-full.txt** (<https://anotherseoguru.com/llms-full.txt>) - Complete knowledge base: services, pricing, locations, portfolio, blog, FAQs.
